title: LibraryList
description: The extended Library (#864, agents/research/redesign/lap2/LIBRARY.md): things and files in one list, one server answer for the creator and the deck (GET /api/library, server/docs/API.md "The extended Library"). The server resolves – types, kinds, names, pictures, places, used in – the apps only read. Edit this file, run `npm run generate` (server/schema/generate.ts writes the TS and PHP types), commit the outputs; library.vectors.json holds the file cases every reader holds to.

ThingType.description: What a thing is (owner 2026-11-24, LIBRARY.md "Answered" 1): a toon, a character, a deck scene, a live show, a place of the world map, a catalog item (with its subtype), a rig module, an instrument, a rig, a generator (the storyboard's providers), and for now a Kanon text and a person (for credits). Its address is its entity key (`toon:catpope`, `character:catpope`, `scene:nave`, `show:duet`, `place:dom`, `item:camera`, `recipe:x`, `product:x`, `edition:x`, `album:x`, `home-scene:x`, `module:walk`, `instrument:organ`, `rig:character.catpope`, `kanon:character.catpope:de`), a generator's `generator:<id>`, a person's `person:<id>`.

ItemSubtype.description: An item's subtype: a catalog entry of its own table listed as an item – absent on a plain item (`item:<id>`).

FileKind.description: What a file is: the registry's kind, where `archive`, `document`, `font` and `other` are a `file`. Its address is `<kind>:<path>` – the kind and the current version's main file (CDN-root path), as the Library opens it.

FileOrigin.description: Where a file came from (the From place): its main file's origin in the registry.

LinkRole.description: How a thing uses another: `cast` (a season's cast lists the character), `credits` (a toon's credits name the person), `rig` (a character or item plays this rig; a rig plays this instrument or module), `reference` (the document names it: an address in a scene or show, a character or item in a chapter's events, an item in a recipe or product, a file in a document).

LevelKind.description: A level inside a thing: a character's persona › look › mood, a toon's season › chapter.

LibraryEntry.description: One entry: a thing (with `type`) or a file (with `kind`), never both.

address.description: the identity: a thing's address (ThingType) or a file's `<kind>:<path>`

name.description: what a person reads: the label in the asked locale (the one locale order), else the id; a file's title, else its slug

picture.description: a thumbnail's URL (the CDN's): a file's smallest picture (an image's, a video's poster), a thing's picture (a character's default look, a toon's tile, an item's icon, a place's image) – null where there is no still yet (a model, a scene, a module)

parent.description: the thing it belongs to: a rig's character or item, a Kanon text's subject

toons.description: the toons it belongs to (the place This toon); empty = shared by every toon (an instrument, a template scene, a file no toon uses)

usedIn.description: how many things use it (a file: how many documents; a character: its casts, scenes, shows, chapters …)

updated.description: when it last changed (ISO 8601, UTC): a thing's newest version, a file's registry entry – the place Recently added

LibraryCounts.description: How many entries of each type and kind the place holds before the type / kind filter (the type select's numbers): `character`, `image`, …

LibraryList.description: GET /api/library[?toon=&place=&type=&subtype=&kind=&from=&locale=&cursor=&limit=]: a page of one place's entries – things first (in ThingType's order), then files (in FileKind's order), each by address.

version.description: the answer's version (the ETag without quotes)

toon.description: the toon asked for; null = the universe

total.description: the entries the place and the filters hold, every page together

next.description: the cursor of the next page; null = the last page

LibraryLevel.description: One level inside a thing, parents before children. A mood has no address of its own (the address grammar ends at the look, space rig/address.rs): its `address` is its look's, `mood` names it.

parent.description: the level (or the thing) one up

LibraryLink.description: A thing that uses the stepped-into one ("used in"): a link to open.

address.description: its address (a season's cast: `season:<toon>:<n>`, a chapter: `chapter:<toon>:<n>` – documents that are no entry of the list are linked too)

LibraryStep.description: GET /api/library?at=<address>[&locale=]: a thing stepped into – its levels, the files it uses, the things it uses, the things that use it; a file's `at` answers its entry and what uses it.

files.description: the files it uses (the place This item's files)
